research_question: How should a reader judge whether a crypto airdrop is safe to claim and worth holding?

research_brief.purpose: Give readers a checkable due-diligence process for airdrop claims, covering both security and token economics.
research_brief.audience: Retail crypto users who receive or seek airdrops, and readers assessing whether a claim is safe.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Scam figures cover crypto scams broadly, not airdrops alone. The post gives a process, not a list of current airdrops, and makes no recommendation to claim or hold any token.

keyword_research.intent: Informational, with navigational searches for airdrop listings

sources.title: Record $17 Billion Estimated Stolen in Crypto Scams and Fraud in 2025 as Impersonation Tactics and AI Enablement Surge
sources.scope: On-chain inflows to addresses attributed to scams
sources.method: Blockchain analysis of identified scam addresses
sources.limitations: A lower bound that rises as more addresses are identified; covers scams broadly, not airdrops alone

sources.title: Cyber Criminals Defraud Hedera Hashgraph Network Non-Custodial Wallet Users Through Nonfungible Token Airdrops Disguised as Free Rewards
sources.scope: A specific airdrop phishing technique on one network
sources.limitations: The FBI page blocks automated access; content confirmed from the identical announcement published by IC3 as PSA250603

statistics.claim: Cryptocurrency scams received at least $14 billion on-chain in 2025; the 2025 figure could exceed $17 billion; the 2024 figure was $12 billion at recalculation.
statistics.limitations: Lower bound; the $17 billion figure is a projection

statistics.claim: The average scam payment rose from $782 in 2024 to $2,764 in 2025, an increase of 253%.
statistics.population: Payments to addresses Chainalysis attributes to scams

headings: How to participate in crypto airdrops

competitors.title: What is a crypto airdrop and how does it work?
headings: Why do crypto development teams do airdrops?
competitors.covered_well: A balanced overview with pros, cons, and a tax warning from a regulated brokerage.
competitors.gaps: Dated January 2024; nothing on approvals, supply, liquidity, or scam data.

content_gaps: Ranking pages define airdrops or list them; none walks through what a wallet signature or approval grants.
No ranking page reviewed gives sourced scam figures.
Token economics (circulating supply, unlocks, holder concentration, liquidity) are absent from the explainers.
None gives a stop-list of red flags tied to a step-by-step check.
value_add: A due-diligence process that treats the claim as two questions, whether it is safe to interact with and whether the token is worth holding, supported by sourced scam data and two charts.

plan.reader_title: Crypto Airdrop Risk: How to Evaluate Tokens Before You Claim
plan.seo_title: Crypto Airdrop Risk: How to Evaluate Tokens Safely
plan.meta_description: Learn how to evaluate a crypto airdrop, check token legitimacy, inspect wallet permissions, and reduce phishing and smart-contract risk.
